comment: mhitu.c explmu() 1617-1621: an exploding monster survives mon_explodes() through life saving, so explmu() clears kill_agr (1621). A debug Valkyrie (monpolycontrol) drops a wished amulet of life saving beside a tame djinni, which picks it up and puts it on; she zaps a wand of polymorph at it and answers 'flaming sphere' (mon_break_armor keeps the amulet), then puts on a ring of conflict, so the sphere explodes at her; its amulet saves it ('The flaming sphere reconstitutes!') and the explosion's damage kills her, which debug mode declines.
